what_changed: News, no print: Meta's 8-K Item 8.01 (filed 2026-11-23) says no Class C shares will be issued, by dividend or otherwise, during the pre-trial and trial proceedings of the Delaware Class C suits (trial set for 2027-04-19), and the ~$60B ATM will not launch until the Class C dividend is paid. The base round booked $22.0B of ATM sales by the 2027-10-27 horizon at p 0.80 from ~2027-02-01. Now none is booked by the horizon (no Class C can be issued before a post-trial ruling that permits the dividend, trial from 2027-04-19, date and outcome unknown; starts from 2027-05-15 and 2027-07-01 are sized as alternatives at +0.05% and +0.03%). The net debt roll had also credited the $17.6B of expected ATM cash while the engine credited its interest again through the financing event; with the ATM gone, the roll funds that gap with debt at 4.5% and net interest rises to 5,520 / 8,284 / 13,148 (was 4,712 / 7,462 / 12,294). Engine value on 2026-11-24: 528.39 -> 525.83 (-0.5%): -0.07% from dropping the ATM shares and cash, -0.41% from the higher net interest. Operating drivers, multiples, guidance_check and thesis triggers unchanged; the driver news log had no driver moves for META.
